shared_elements: shallow relief carving on a weathered rough surface
vertical composition with elements stacked top to bottom
justification: Both are tall, upright, heavily weathered stone monuments carved in shallow relief and photographed frontally, and both include rounded disc-like motifs and stacked vertical registers of carving. The decisive difference is that A's surface is organised as regular columns of repeated rectangular sign-blocks with no figure, whereas B is dominated by a single large anthropomorphic form with head, headdress, pectoral and arms, giving quite different compositional logic and carving manner.
